hazards: rapidly rising water, submerged access roads
report: Flood warning for the low-lying Riverside residential area. Water is rising rapidly and there are reports that some residents may be trapped.
A tree branch has fallen and is blocking one lane of Oak Lane, a secondary road. No injuries are confirmed and traffic can still pass on the other lane.
Power outage affecting a small commercial area around Market Square. No immediate hazard is reported; a few shops are without electricity.

hazards: smoke and flames visible, people inside
report: Residential building fire at 12 Pine Street. Smoke and flames are visible and there are reports of people still inside the building.

hazards: smell of gas, risk of explosion
report: Gas leak reported at 88 Cedar Avenue. Several residents are being evacuated and there is a risk of explosion.

hazards: vehicles on roadway, possible fuel spill
report: Multi-vehicle collision on Highway 9 northbound. Three people are reported injured and there may be a fuel spill.

hazards: slow water leak from a pipe
report: A shop at 5 Maple Court reports a slow water leak from a pipe. There is no flooding and no injuries.
A loud outdoor gathering on Park Road is disturbing neighbours. There is no danger and no injuries, just noise late at night.
A power line has come down outside 42 Birch Lane and the wire is lying on the ground. No one is reported hurt but the area is energised.

hazards: cold night, exposure, overdue several hours
report: A lone hiker is reported overdue on the Ridge Trail as night falls and temperatures drop. They have not been seen for several hours.
